name: Tida URL Screenshot
author: Tidaweb

sections.description:
The Tida URL Screenshot Plugin has been developed by the professional team at Tida Web. Tida Web is a leading company in Website Design, offering services such as Corporate Website Design, E-Commerce Store Development, and Custom WordPress Plugin Programming.

This plugin utilizes a third-party web service to receive a URL from the user and provide a screenshot of the requested page. Additionally, the plugin supports taking screenshots of a custom post type, making it a versatile and practical tool for various user needs.

Supported API Services

  • abstractapi.com / Privacy Policy
  • apiflash.com / Privacy Policy
  • screenshotlayer.com / Privacy Policy
  • screenshotmachine.com / Privacy Policy
  • screenshotone.com / Privacy Policy
  • New API Coming Soon

Features

  • [tida_screenshot] shortcode for showing the URL Screenshot form.
  • Enable a button for taking screenshots on custom post types.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the wp-content/plugins/tida-url-screenshot directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. You can configure the plugin through the Settings menu in the WordPress dashboard
  4. (Make your instructions match the desired user flow for activating and installing your plugin. Include any steps that might be needed for explanatory purposes)
sections.faq:
How I use this plugin

You can add shortcode [tida_screenshot] in anywhere of your website like page or page builders blocks.

How I get a api key

You must go to website that you select in api key service, then sign up and get a free api key.
